sponsors.name: USDC (Circle)
sponsors.verdict: Owned by Circle Internet Group, Inc. (NYSE: CRCL) — public shareholders. Nothing found.

source.name: Chelsea FC, Circle partner page
source.note: Circle Internet Group is a Principal Partner and official front-of-shirt partner beginning with the 2026/27 season; in 2026/27 the Circle and USDC brands appear on the front of Chelsea's Men's, Women's and Academy shirts.

source.name: Chelsea FC, Here We Flo partner page
source.note: Here We Flo is Chelsea FC Women's Official Back of Short partner.

source.name: Chelsea FC, Škoda partner page
source.note: Chelsea FC Women first teamed up with Škoda UK at the start of 2024 as Official Car Partner; the May 2025 extension established Škoda as Chelsea Women's first Official Back of Shirt Partner.
